description: This file defines a CompositionLocal for TimeZone in Jetpack Compose, providing a way to supply the current system default TimeZone throughout the UI without passing it explicitly to each composable.

methods.name: compositionLocalOf
methods.description: Creates a CompositionLocal instance to hold a TimeZone, providing a default value based on the current system timezone.

methods.name: TimeZone.currentSystemDefault
methods.description: Returns the system default timezone as a TimeZone object.
